annotations.text:
Direction: THE ARCHIVE

A health record is a document you own, not a dashboard you visit. Parchment ground, warm ink, editorial serif for voice, monospace for anything cryptographic — so proof always looks like proof.

Deliberately not medical-blue: that convention says "hospital software". This says "your record".

These are live, not pictures.

Access (both sizes) — hit Revoke on any grant and watch it seal, fade and drop out of the live count.

Web · Record — click any row to load it into the detail pane; the filter chips filter.

Phone · Home — Overview / Activity swap.
Phone · Keys — the two custody modes swap the key card.

Web is not the phone stretched.

Home puts the access table and the activity feed side by side instead of behind a tab.

Access shows pending requests in a right rail, so approving does not mean navigating away.

Record becomes list + detail — the one pattern a phone genuinely cannot do.

Not yet drawn: onboarding / DID provisioning, present-QR-to-clinician, emergency break-glass, insurance, telemedicine. Web · Keys is phone-only so far.

All names, dates, DIDs and hashes are sample data.

WEB — 1440 × 900

Sidebar shell, 248px. Same tokens and components as the phone, denser rhythm and a search affordance.

PHONE — 390 × 844

Four-tab bar. No fake status bar: on a real device the OS draws its own over this.
